question: In which city did the freedom fighter Chandrashekhar Azad shoot himself on being besieged by the British police?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allahabad**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chandrashekhar Azad shoot himself on being besieged by the British police in Allahabad.
 
• **On February 27, 1931,** betrayed by one of the associates, he was besieged by the British police in **Alfred Park, Allahabad.**
 
• He fought valiantly but seeing no other way he shot himself and fulfilled his resolve to die a **'free man'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chandrashekhar Azad was born on 23rd July 1906 in Bhavra village of Madhya Pradesh. 
 
• He joined the non-cooperation movement at the age of 15.
 
• He joined the Hindustan Republican Association after the suspension of the non-cooperation movement. 
 
• He was associated with the Kakori conspiracy which was the Kakori train Incident conducted by Hindustan Republican Association in 1925. 
 
• The Hindustan Socialist Republic Association was established by Chandrashekhar Azad and his colleagues in 1928 at Feroz Shah Kotla, New Delhi. 
 
• He was involved in 1926 attempt to blow the viceroys train and Saunder's shooting in 1928.
